degree_rationale: The Five Greatnesses going forth against Darkness, with the redemptive descent reaching Adam through Jesus, the great judicial-paternal lineage. Treats the essential structure of the redemptive economy from First Man through Jesus to Adam.
direction_rationale: Wisdom illumining how the Greatness reaches all the way down into the molding of Adam through Jesus — the great salvific midday seen in its breadth.
grand_man_function: Celestial redemptive lineage — the inmost reach of love from Father to Adam.
title: The Twelve Greatnesses and the redemptive descent reaching Adam through Jesus
